description: Rider activity: three additive changes. (a) Extend admin_audit_logs with OPTIONAL entity_id + date-range filters (backward-compatible, no new required params; endpoint already IsAdminUser and consumed only by the admin frontend, not mobile). (b) Add an audit-log entry to delete_rider BEFORE user.delete() (hard delete stays; the ONLY change to delete_rider). (c) Add a NEW admin-only endpoint GET /auth/admin/rider/<rider_id>/activity/ exposing last_login (auth) and last_seen (newest DeviceSession) as distinct fields. Do NOT add last_login/last_seen to serialize_user. Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002. Grounded in: security/views.py ~line 262 admin_audit_logs (filters action/entity_type/limit only); security/services/audit_service.py log_from_request; authapp/views.py ~line 725 delete_rider bare user.delete(); authapp/models.py DeviceSession.last_seen_at; User extends AbstractUser (last_login exists).
steps: In backend/taxi/security/views.py, inside admin_audit_logs, add OPTIONAL filters after the existing action/entity_type ones: entity_id = request.query_params.get('entity_id') -> logs = logs.filter(entity_id=str(entity_id)); date_from/date_to parsed with django.utils.dateparse.parse_date -> logs.filter(created_at__date__gte=...) / created_at__date__lte=...; malformed date -> return Response({...}, status=400) consistent with FEAT-001/002. Keep the existing action, entity_type, and limit behavior unchanged (no new REQUIRED params).

In backend/taxi/authapp/views.py, import log_from_request from security.services.audit_service, and in delete_rider add exactly ONE change: immediately BEFORE user.delete(), call log_from_request(request, action='admin_action', entity_type='customer', entity_id=user.id, summary=f'Rider deleted: {user.email}', details={'email': user.email}). Do NOT change the hard-delete behavior, the staff/driver guards, or the response. Do NOT log password, tokens, or document contents.

In backend/taxi/authapp/views.py add a NEW view admin_rider_activity(request, rider_id) decorated @api_view(['GET']) + @permission_classes([IsAdminUser]). Resolve the rider via get_object_or_404(User, id=rider_id) with the same not-a-rider -> 404 rule used in FEAT-001/002. Return Response({'last_login': user.last_login, 'last_seen': <newest DeviceSession.last_seen_at or None>, 'last_seen_device': <that session's device_name or None>}). Compute last_seen via DeviceSession.objects.filter(user=user).order_by('-last_seen_at').first(). Do NOT modify serialize_user.
Register the route in backend/taxi/authapp/urls.py: path('admin/rider/<int:rider_id>/activity/', admin_rider_activity) and import the view.

Add tests in backend/taxi/tests/security/test_admin_rider_activity.py following tests/operations/test_admin_permissions.py. Cover: (audit filters) seeding AuditLog rows with different entity_id/created_at and asserting entity_id + date filters narrow results while omitting them preserves existing behavior; a non-admin is denied. (delete_rider) calling the delete endpoint as admin creates an AuditLog with action='admin_action', entity_type='customer', entity_id == str(rider id) BEFORE deletion, and the user is actually deleted. (activity) anonymous -> 401/403; non-staff rider -> 403; admin -> 200 with distinct last_login and last_seen (seed a DeviceSession and assert last_seen matches the newest; assert null -> null, not fabricated).
acceptance_criteria: admin_audit_logs accepts OPTIONAL entity_id, date_from, date_to and still works with none of them supplied (backward compatible); malformed date -> 400.
delete_rider writes an AuditLog (action=admin_action, entity_type=customer, entity_id=<rider id>) BEFORE user.delete(), and no other behavior of delete_rider changes.
GET /auth/admin/rider/<rider_id>/activity/ exists, is IsAdminUser-gated, and returns distinct last_login and last_seen (null when unavailable; never fabricated).
serialize_user is NOT modified; no existing endpoint behavior is broken; no migration is added.
Running `<venv-python> manage.py test tests.security.test_admin_rider_activity` passes all new tests.
verification: cd backend/taxi; c:\Users\Housseinou\Projects\Django\taxi-booking\backend\taxi\.venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py test tests.security authapp
findings: Implemented all three additive changes; tests green (new module 11/11; `manage.py test tests.security authapp` = 43 OK). ENDPOINT FOR FRONTEND: GET /auth/admin/rider/<rider_id>/activity/ (IsAdminUser-gated; auth prefix is `auth/`). Not-a-rider (staff/superuser/has DriverProfile) -> 404 {"detail": "Not found."}; non-staff rider -> 403; anonymous -> 401/403. Success 200 JSON shape: {"last_login": <ISO8601 datetime string | null>, "last_seen": <ISO8601 datetime string | null>, "last_seen_device": <string | null>}. `last_login` is User.last_login (auth); `last_seen` is the newest DeviceSession.last_seen_at; `last_seen_device` is that session's device_name ("" possible if unnamed). All three are null (never fabricated) when no activity exists -> frontend shows N/A. serialize_user was NOT modified. admin_audit_logs (GET /security/admin/audit-logs/) now also accepts OPTIONAL entity_id, date_from, date_to (YYYY-MM-DD; malformed -> 400); omitting them preserves prior behavior. delete_rider writes an AuditLog (action=admin_action, entity_type=customer, entity_id=<rider id>, details={email}) BEFORE the existing hard user.delete(); no other delete_rider behavior changed. No model changes or migrations.
